abstract: Adnexal torsion is an unusual, but serious complication in pregnancy. The treatment is surgical, but this may increase the risk of pregnancy loss in the first trimester. The use of laparoscopic surgery, which is less invasive than traditional laparotomy, has been limited by diagnostic and technical difficulties including determination of ovarian tumor nature and spillage of cyst contents intraoperatively. A 25-year-old woman in her 11th week of pregnancy had acute severe left lower-abdominal pain, which was diagnosed as left ovarian teratoma with torsion. She underwent emergency laparoscopic surgery with unwinding of the twisted fallopian tube and ovary and cystectomy of the teratoma. The patient subsequently delivered a full-term baby, without complications. Accurate ultrasound and cytologic diagnoses along with copious intraoperative warm, normal saline irrigation were likely contributing factors to the successful outcome of this case.
abstract_ja: 子宮付属器捻転は妊娠中にまれだが重篤な合併症である。治療は外科的であるが、妊娠初期では流産のリスクを高める可能性がある。腹腔鏡手術は開腹術より侵襲が少ないが、卵巣腫瘍の性質の判定や術中の嚢胞内容物の漏出といった診断上および技術上の困難により、その適用は限られてきた。妊娠11週の25歳女性が急性の重度の左下腹部痛を訴え、左卵巣奇形腫の捻転と診断された。緊急腹腔鏡手術により、捻転した卵管と卵巣を解除し、奇形腫の嚢腫摘出を行った。患者は合併症なく正期産で出産した。正確な超音波検査と細胞診による診断、および術中の温生理食塩水による十分な洗浄が、本症例の良好な転帰の寄与因子であったと考えられる。
